description: Na₃Nd₂(NO₃)₉ crystallizes in the cubic P4_132 space group. Na is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-3.03 Å. Nd is bonded to twelve O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NdO₁₂ cuboctahedra. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.56-2.78 Å. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.25 Å) and two longer (1.28 Å) N-O bond lengths. In the second N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.25 Å) and one longer (1.29 Å) N-O bond length. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Nd and one N atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Nd, and one N atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Nd, and one N atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and one N atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Nd, and one N atom.
